note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #32, Q4 2024 Conflicts) keeps INEGI columns bp2_1..bp2_4_11 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_1224.csv (imported lowercased) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); the bookmark is identical to Q3's #27 apart from the input dataset and output name (diffed). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's own Q4 data dictionary labels each BP2_* column (e.g. BP2_2_16 'Conflictos o enfrentamientos: Grafiti o pintas a su casa por alguien que usted identifique'; BP2_3_4 'Incidentes o problemas con desconocidos(as) en la calle'; BP2_4_09 'Tipo de consecuencias derivadas de conflictos: Dialogo/platica'); 37/37 labels agree in content with the Q4 questionnaire option carrying the same code number. Q4 vs Q3 source check (done, not assumed): the Q4 questionnaire's Section II is textually identical to Q3's -- CP2 introduction (Q3's reworded 'Las situaciones conflictivas pueden ser parte de nuestra vida cotidiana...' is retained), 2.1-2.4 stems ('familiares' spelled correctly), all 18+7+11 options, codes and skip instructions; the pdftotext diff of pp.3-4 differs only in dot leaders/spacing, page layout order and the footer (Cuarto trimestre ... 2025), and 80-dpi renders of pp.3-4 were read to confirm. All 41 Spanish strings shipped (CP2 intro, 3 section stems, 37 item texts) are found in the Q4 text layer after whitespace/dot-leader normalisation. Q4 dictionary vs Q3: same 37 BP2_* variables; three label edits, all cosmetic and none affecting shipped text (item_text comes from the questionnaire): BP2_2_01 'uso del taladro' -> 'uso de taladro' (now matches the print), BP2_4_05 'etc.)' -> 'etcetera)' (matches the print), BP2_4_09 'Dialogo o platica' -> 'Dialogo/platica' (print reads 'Dialogo / platica'). All 37 bp2_* catalogos are byte-identical to Q3's. INEGI-side oddity, no effect: the Q4 dictionary's PER range reads '0424'. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 37 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI Q4 2024 CSV after the .do's recodes, 74/74 item x level counts (e.g. bp2_1 1/2 = 9329/14112, bp2_2_16 0/1 = 8624/705, bp2_2_18 0/1 = 7948/1381, bp2_4_09 0/1 = 3555/4393); raw has 23451 rows, 10 bp2_1=9 set missing by the .do -> 23441 live ids (those 10 are also blank on every later bp2 item); 3 respondents' bp2_3_*=9 set missing on all 7 bp2_3 items (bp2_3 n = 7945). Words: item_text / section_prompt / instructions are the administered questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials), not the terser dictionary labels. Kept as printed: '(as)' gender fills, trailing '?' on 2.2 options and the stem's trailing ellipsis. Normalised: line wraps joined with a space. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blanks after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'B' Y CIRCULE UN SOLO CODIGO / LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; PASE A LA SECCION III; SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 18 'NINGUNO', PASE A LA SECCION III). Structure (same as batch_672/676/680): section _1 = 2.1 screener (stem in item_text), _2 = 2.2 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _3 = 2.3, _4 = 2.4; instructions = CP2 read-aloud introduction. Options: bp2_1 1=Si, 2=No (questionnaire and catalogo; 9 'No sabe / no responde' set missing by the .do, no row). The 36 checklist items are 0/1 flags; option_text is INEGI's catalogo value label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si'), not questionnaire print. Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Routing (not a defect): 2.2 asked only if 2.1=Si (n=9329 = bp2_1 Si count); 2.3/2.4 skipped when 2.2 code 18 'Ninguno' was circled (7948 = 9329 - 1381; bp2_3 n=7945 after the 3 code-9 respondents). Step 3b: live items match this question block exactly (37 = 1 + 18 + 7 + 11); dictionary Description ('Q4 2024') is accurate, but the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2024 Q4 (diciembre 2024, file suffix 1224) wave -- same defect as the Q1/Q2/Q3 siblings. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation), reused verbatim from batch_680 for every field since all Spanish is identical to Q3; nothing translated fresh. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, cuarto trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section II (questions 2.1-2.4) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
